pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 27
   C. 25
   D. 31

2. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 122

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 30
   C. 42
   D. 90

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

5. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 12.5
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 6

6. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

7. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

9. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 169

11. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 81

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15

13. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 18

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

15. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

16. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 1

17. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

18. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

19. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 10

20. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

21. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 33

22. Solve for x: x + 6 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 16
   C. 10
   D. 11

23. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 73
   D. 17

24. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

25. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 66
   C. 34
   D. 17

26. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

27. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 1, 6

28. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 49

29. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 24

30. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 23.7
